TEXT: Why is he called SS? NL Because when his parents were fighting Voldemort, NL they had no bloodline from the House of Potter, so magic struck his forehead NL and left two lightning-shaped scars, one on each side, NL forming a shape like a disulfide bond — hence the name.
"Is this something the Defect has never seen before?"

On a dim street, you come across a few hooded figures performing some kind of dark ritual. As you step closer, they all turn to face you at the same time, which feels deeply uncanny. The tallest of them gives a faint smile, revealing long fangs, and extends a pale, slender hand toward you: NL ~"Join us, little brat. Come feel the warmth of the Spire with us."~
